text: Then, taking green lead (orpiment) moistened with the auspiciousness of the fingers, and a mind-stone (a stone used for concentration), along with a leaf of the Alodanta plant, the mother raised her daughter’s face. The desire of Uma, which had been stirred up and grown strong, was the first to arise; and in some way, she performed the marriage-vow and the tilaka (sacred mark) on her daughter.
